contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin fragment. Penny of Aethelred II (978-1016), bent with loss of part of legend, Spink no. 1144, citing BMC IIa, issue of 978-991. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: (--)EDELRED(--). Reverse description: Hand of God with small chevron on its sleeve pointing downwards flanked by Alpha and Omega, both letters drawn with a bar above them.…
